articles.summary: This article shows you how you can use SQL in Rust with SQLx - you will find a rundown of all the advantages SQLx offers you, the best ways to use it and how to use SQLx with Shuttle.
articles.title: Raw SQL in Rust with SQLx

articles.summary: This article details how to build a GraphQL server in Rust. We will explore using queries, mutations as well as subscriptions to make a fully working endpoint.
articles.title: Using GraphQL in Rust
